commit_message: Fix Managed Local UI worker boundaries
pr_title: Fix Managed Local AI UI worker boundaries
pr_body:
## Summary

- reuse one frozen Managed Local resource config across Managed Play capability planning and transition startup instead of resolving it twice
- keep ADR 0155 Enforced verification inside the native model-turn and model-resource workers now present on current main
- add worker-boundary regression coverage for Go/native model turns and Release/Reload resource transitions on both WindowsNative and Wsl2Linux

## Scope

The previously separate Managed Local completion work is now merged to main. This PR contains only the remaining UI-thread/resource-transition deduplication and regression coverage requested here.

No presentation/layout behavior changes; Visual Validation is not requested.
